note: ROBUSTNESS AND SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS -- not an optimization or proof of optimal values. See parameter_robustness_sweep's own docstring: no ground-truth label set exists to optimize these parameters against.

evidence_labels.synthetic_fixed: The fixed, hand-engineered 18-candidate _rpi_sensitivity_panel -- fast and fully reproducible, NOT real pipeline data.
evidence_labels.real_discrimination_panel: The actual a/b1/b2/c panel built from reference isolates -- real data, but only the pass/fail overall_ranking_supported summary at each grid point, not a rank correlation (the panel groups are not individually rankable against a baseline the way the synthetic panel is).
